item.title: Eight Bells: George M. Uznis
item.description: George M. Uznis, 76, of Fort Lauderdale, FL and Bay Harbor, MI passed away peacefully January 19, 2026, surrounded by his loving family. He was a former resident of Grosse Pointe Farms, MI. George lived life to the fullest and was fueled by his passion for the water and sailing. A renowned sailor, he earned the coveted “Double Goat” designation by completing more than 25 Bayview–Mackinac races and more than 25 Chicago Yacht Club Races to Mackinac. - Full report

item.title: Less confrontation, Better sport
item.description: Sailing, like all sports, has rules, but that's where the comparison ends. item.title: Curmudgeon’s Observation
item.description: It’s hard to explain puns to kleptomaniacs because they always take things literally. Providing “insight” since 1997, the Curmudgeon’s Observation has been a hallmark of the Scuttlebutt Newsletter which delivers a digest of major sailing news, commentary, opinions, features and dock talk…with a North American focus.
